ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: wyrmcaller
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: A Wyrmcaller is one half of a pair. The other half starts the size of a cat and ends the size of a barn, and every bit of it is hers: its fire, its hunger, its temper and its absolute certainty that she is the most important thing in the world.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Hatch a dragon. Raise it. It grows when you do, and most of your spells are things it does.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Is it safe?' asked the trader. 'No,' she said, scratching it under the chin. 'That's rather the point.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: You begin with an egg. The wyrm is a colony animal you can zone, train to haul and rescue and load for caravans, and it is a hatchling until you reach the Second Circle (drake) and the Fourth (great wyrm); every level you gain makes it stronger. Most spells start from the wyrm, so where it stands matters: Wyrmfire is a cone from its jaws, Stoop drops it on a target, Terrible Roar scatters whatever is near it, Hunt sets it on one enemy and Heel calls it back. At home it sheds scales to tailor, hauls, scouts and gives rides. If it dies you may hatch another after three days. Wants Attunement and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: soulbound
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: The Soulbound stopped being able to tell where she ends and the wyrm begins. Neither of them minds.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Two bodies, one life. Share wounds, trade places, grow scales of your own, and burn the field from wyrmback.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: When she stubs her toe, something the size of a barn looks up and growls.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Your wyrm becomes a pale spirit wyrm that shrugs off blows and heals fast. Shared Heart halves the wounds either of you takes, Trade Places swaps you in an instant, Blood Offering spends your blood to mend it, and Rekindle brings it back from the dead. Draconic Aspect gives you scales, claws and a breath of your own (Wyrmfire then comes from both of you), Fury of Two makes the wyrm spit fire by itself, and Skyfire is a strafing run with you on its back. Wants Attunement and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: hoardkeeper
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Hoardkeepers understand what every dragon understands: that there is no such thing as enough.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: A dragon is as strong as its hoard. Get rich, and let the gold wyrm show the raiders what your wealth is for.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The raiders came for the silver. They stayed, in a sense. Several of them are quite valuable now.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Your wyrm turns gold, armoured like a vault. Its power is the colony's wealth: Dragon's Greed gives spell power for every 100,000 silver the colony is worth. It smells out hidden ore, sits on a hoard that pays silver every day, and breathes molten gold that slows, burns and leaves real gold behind when the victim dies. Coin Storm, Plunder and the Golden Age round out a class that pays for itself. Wants Attunement and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: broodmother
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: A Broodmother's wyrm lays. Constantly. What hatches is small, fast, furious and fiercely loyal to its grandmother.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: One dragon is a weapon. A brood is a problem. Clutches of drakelings, egg bombs, and a nest that feeds the colony.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: She stopped naming them after the first two hundred.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Your wyrm becomes a red brood wyrm, quick and savage. Clutch lays eggs that hatch into drakelings, Egg Bomb throws one that explodes into fire and another drakeling, Pounce sends the whole brood onto one target, and Culling feeds them back to the wyrm to heal it and make it stronger. At home a Nest lays eggs for the kitchen, the Brood Hunts for meat, and Brooding hatches every fertilized egg in the barn. Wants Attunement and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: deep breath
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Wyrmfire reaches farther and burns hotter.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: firebrand
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything draconic burns: your Draconic spells often lay an extra stack of wyrmfire.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: wyrmkin
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You are a little draconic yourself. Each Draconic spell restores a little of you, and animals of every kind listen to you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: thermals
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Stoop and Dragonflight come back sooner and land harder.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: dragonlord
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: It fights as you think. Wyrmfire and Stoop come back far sooner and everything draconic hits harder.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: wyrmfriend
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: More pet than weapon. Molt, Dragon Rides, Hoard Run, Skyward Scout and Hatch Wyrm come back twice as fast.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: heart of the wyrm
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: It knows who you are angry at. A quarter of your Draconic hits also set the wyrm on that enemy.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: entwined
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Shared Heart lasts longer and comes back sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: lifeblood
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: What feeds one feeds both. A little lifesteal, and you take 5% less damage per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: wingspan
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Draconic Aspect lasts longer and returns sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: twin flame
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Two throats, one fire: Wyrmfire and Fury of Two burn 20% hotter per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: undying bond
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: It will not let you go either. Once a day, when you would die, you rise again in a burst of wyrmfire; and Rekindle returns twice as fast.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: dragonheart
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: More dragon than mage. Draconic Aspect lasts twice as long, everything draconic hits harder, and fire barely touches you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: crucible
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Molten Gold burns hotter and comes back sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: dragon's greed
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: A dragon is as strong as its hoard. +3% spell power per rank for every 100,000 silver the colony is worth, up to +12% per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: tithe
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything that dies pays you something. Each kill restores mana.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: mint
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Coin Storm: four more strikes per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: a nose for it
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Sniff Out Treasure finds a third vein and comes back sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: king under the mountain
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Sit on it. A further +4% spell power per 100,000 silver of colony wealth (up to +20%) and a stronger ward.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: the golden touch
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything you burn is gilded: Draconic hits often leave their target gold-clad, and Molten Gold and Coin Storm return sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: large clutch
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: One more egg per clutch per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: pack tactics
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Pounce lands harder and comes back sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: hatchery
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything lays better near a broodmother. Every hour, tame animals within ten cells of you come 1.5% closer to their next egg, milking or shearing.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: swarm
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Death is an opportunity. Your kills sometimes throw an Egg Bomb at the next enemy.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: provider
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The Brood Hunts brings down two more animals and returns sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: legion
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: There are always more. Two more eggs in every clutch, and drakelings last half again as long.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: devourer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The brood exists to feed the mother. Culling returns twice as fast and heals half again as much, and everything draconic hits harder.

AbilityDef.label: hatch wyrm
AbilityDef.description: Hatch your wyrm: a bonded dragon for life. It arrives as a hatchling, fully trained, and grows into a drake at the Second Circle and a great wyrm at the Fourth. Only one at a time; if it dies you can hatch another when this spell returns.

li.flavor: It looked at her first. That was that.

AbilityDef.label: wyrmfire
AbilityDef.description: Your wyrm breathes a cone of fire toward the target: 22 wyrmfire and a clinging burn that stacks, eight cells long from wherever the wyrm is standing. It sets the ground alight.

AbilityDef.label: hunt
AbilityDef.description: Point. Your wyrm drops whatever it is doing and goes for that enemy, a third faster and striking far more often for ten seconds.

AbilityDef.label: heel
AbilityDef.description: Call your wyrm back. It takes wing and lands at your side.

AbilityDef.label: stoop
AbilityDef.description: Your wyrm takes wing and comes down on the target point like a falling wall: 45 damage within three cells, a two-second stun, and everything there set burning.

AbilityDef.label: terrible roar
AbilityDef.description: Your wyrm roars. Enemies within seven cells of it run in terror for four seconds, shooting and striking badly; allies there are emboldened for fifteen.

AbilityDef.label: dragonscale
AbilityDef.description: Press a freshly shed scale over an ally's heart. For a minute blades skid off (+40% armour), fire does nothing to them and they cannot be set alight.

AbilityDef.label: devour
AbilityDef.description: Feed your wyrm a corpse. It flies to it and eats it whole (gear is left behind): 60 healing for every point of the body's size, a full belly, and half a minute of fast healing and harder blows. The colony's own dead are not on the menu.

AbilityDef.label: dragonflight
AbilityDef.description: Climb on. You and your wyrm fly to the target point together and land hard: 30 damage and a stagger to enemies within two and a half cells.

AbilityDef.label: molt
AbilityDef.description: Help your wyrm shed. It leaves 12 to 20 wyrm scales where it stands: tailor them like leather into armour that turns blades, ignores fire and keeps its wearer comfortable in any weather.

li.flavor: It itches. Everyone knows when it itches.

AbilityDef.label: hoard run
AbilityDef.description: Send your wyrm to fetch. Up to forty things lying within seven cells of the target point are snatched up and carried straight to wherever they are stored.

AbilityDef.label: skyward scout
AbilityDef.description: Your wyrm climbs until it is a dot and looks down. The map is revealed within forty cells of it.

AbilityDef.label: dragon rides
AbilityDef.description: Everyone gets a turn. Colonists within six cells of your wyrm gain 40% recreation and +8 mood for three days; with Biotech, children also gain 5 growth points and half a bar of learning.

li.flavor: Hold on to the spines. Not that one.

AbilityDef.label: shared heart
AbilityDef.description: For a minute you and your wyrm share one life: each of you takes half of every wound, and a quarter of it is felt by the other.

AbilityDef.label: trade places
AbilityDef.description: You and your wyrm swap places in the blink of an eye, wherever each of you is on the map.

li.flavor: It is hard to ambush someone who is suddenly a dragon.

AbilityDef.label: blood offering
AbilityDef.description: Open a vein for your wyrm. It heals 120 at once; you pay for it with your own blood.

AbilityDef.label: draconic aspect
AbilityDef.description: Take on the dragon for forty-five seconds: scales (+50% armour), claws (+60% melee damage), no fear of fire, and a breath of your own. While it lasts, Wyrmfire comes from you as well as from your wyrm.

AbilityDef.label: fury of two
AbilityDef.description: Your anger becomes its anger. For fifteen seconds your wyrm spits a bolt of wyrmfire at the nearest enemy every second (16 damage and a burn), on top of whatever else it is doing.

AbilityDef.label: rekindle
AbilityDef.description: Refuse to let it go. Target your wyrm's body: it lives again, and the bond with it.

AbilityDef.label: under the wing
AbilityDef.description: Let the whole colony feel what you feel: something enormous is watching over them. Every colonist on the map gains +5 mood for two days.

AbilityDef.label: skyfire
AbilityDef.description: Mount up and burn the field. You and your wyrm fly to the target point, and everything within two and a half cells of the line you fly takes 70 wyrmfire, burns hard and has the ground set alight under it. You land with a blast of 60 more.

AbilityDef.label: molten gold
AbilityDef.description: Your wyrm breathes a cone of molten gold seven cells long: 26 wyrmfire, and everything it coats is gold-clad for ten seconds (half speed, slow to strike, still burning). Whatever dies gold-clad leaves 4 to 10 gold behind.

AbilityDef.label: sniff out treasure
AbilityDef.description: Your wyrm lifts its head and smells metal. The two nearest undiscovered veins of valuable ore (gold, jade, plasteel, uranium, components) are revealed on the map.

AbilityDef.label: dragon's hoard
AbilityDef.description: Heap up a hoard for your wyrm for fifteen days. Once a day it yields silver in proportion to the colony's wealth (15 to 180), as long as your wyrm lives, and it is beautiful enough to lift any room.

AbilityDef.label: coin storm
AbilityDef.description: Your wyrm shakes out its hoard over the enemy: ten strikes of flung coin and plate across the area, 22 damage each. One strike in three leaves a few silver on the ground afterwards.

AbilityDef.label: plunder
AbilityDef.description: Your wyrm covets. Every enemy within five cells of it has its weapon torn from its hands and dropped at your feet; machines and beasts are battered instead.

AbilityDef.label: golden age
AbilityDef.description: Declare a golden age. For a day every colonist on the map works 10% faster, trades a little sharper, is steadier in mind and gains +6 mood.

AbilityDef.label: hoard's wrath
AbilityDef.description: Everything the dragon owns, as fire. Your wyrm breathes a river of molten gold twelve cells long: 110 wyrmfire, harder the richer the colony (+12% for every 100,000 silver of wealth, up to +120%), and everything it touches is gold-clad.

AbilityDef.label: clutch
AbilityDef.description: Your wyrm's brood lays three eggs at the target. Five seconds later they hatch into drakelings that fight for you for ninety seconds.

AbilityDef.label: egg bomb
AbilityDef.description: Lob an egg that was never going to hatch properly. It bursts for 34 wyrmfire within two and a half cells, leaves everything burning, and one very angry drakeling climbs out of the wreckage for a minute.

AbilityDef.label: pounce
AbilityDef.description: Every drakeling you have leaps onto the target point at once. Each lands for 14 damage on whatever is within a cell and a half of it.

AbilityDef.label: culling
AbilityDef.description: The wyrm eats its young. Every drakeling you have is consumed: each heals the wyrm for 40 and makes it 12% stronger and faster for thirty seconds (stacking eight times).

AbilityDef.label: wyrm nest
AbilityDef.description: Scrape out a nest for five days. Twice a day your wyrm leaves two eggs in it, each a meal for six once cooked, and the nest keeps the room warm.

AbilityDef.label: the brood hunts
AbilityDef.description: Let them off the leash. Drakelings bring down the four nearest wild animals on the map (nothing much bigger than a deer) and leave the bodies for the butcher.

AbilityDef.label: brooding
AbilityDef.description: Your wyrm settles over the eggs around a point and warms them. Every fertilized egg within five cells moves halfway to hatching, and any that are ready hatch on the spot: chickens, ducks, anything that lays.

AbilityDef.label: queen's clutch
AbilityDef.description: It rains eggs. Nine egg bombs fall across the area: each bursts for 55 wyrmfire, sets everything burning and hatches a drakeling that fights for a minute.

ThingDef.label: wyrm
ThingDef.description: A dragon, hatched by a Wyrmcaller and bonded to her for life. It grows as she does: a hatchling at first, a drake when she reaches the Second Circle, a great wyrm at the Fourth, and stronger with every level she gains. It can be zoned, trained to haul and rescue, loaded as a pack animal, and it hunts for itself. It does not breed, and it will not outlive its welcome: it lives for thousands of years.

ThingDef.label: wyrm scale
ThingDef.description: Scales shed by a bonded wyrm. Worked like leather, they make armour that turns blades and shrugs off fire, and clothing that is warm in the cold and cool in the heat.

ThingDef.label: wyrm egg (unfert.)
ThingDef.description: An unfertilized egg from a brood wyrm's nest, the size of a helmet. It cooks like any egg and feeds like six.

HediffDef.label: bonded wyrm
HediffDef.description: Bonded to a Wyrmcaller. It grows when she ascends a circle, and every level she gains makes it hit harder, shrug off more and move faster.

HediffDef.label: spirit wyrm
HediffDef.description: Half here and half elsewhere, like the one it is bound to: blows land softer and wounds close faster.

HediffDef.label: gold wyrm
HediffDef.description: Scales like coins and a hide like a vault door.

HediffDef.label: brood wyrm
HediffDef.description: A mother of drakes: fast, fierce and always hungry.

li.label: my wyrm died
li.description: I felt it go. There is a place in my head where it used to be.

li.label: rode a dragon
li.description: I rode a dragon. I am never going to stop talking about it.

li.label: under the wing
li.description: There is a dragon asleep outside and it is on our side. I have never slept better.

HediffDef.label: wyrmfire
HediffDef.description: Wyrmfire clings like oil and keeps burning. Stacks.

HediffDef.label: set upon its prey
HediffDef.description: Loosed on a target: faster on its feet and much faster with tooth and claw.

HediffDef.label: gorged
HediffDef.description: Full of fresh meat: wounds close fast and it hits harder.

HediffDef.label: terrified
HediffDef.description: A dragon roared at it. Every instinct it has says run.

HediffDef.label: emboldened
HediffDef.description: The dragon roared and it was on their side.

HediffDef.label: dragonscale
HediffDef.description: A shed scale, still warm, pressed over the heart: blades skid off and fire does nothing.

HediffDef.label: shared heart
HediffDef.description: Two bodies, one life. Each takes half of every wound, and a quarter of it is felt by the other.

HediffDef.label: draconic aspect
HediffDef.description: Scales over skin, claws for nails, wings of pale fire. While it lasts she breathes wyrmfire along with her wyrm, hits like a hammer and does not burn.

HediffDef.label: fury of two
HediffDef.description: Its mage's anger is its own. Every second it spits a bolt of wyrmfire at the nearest enemy.

HediffDef.label: gold-clad
HediffDef.description: Coated in cooling gold: it burns, it weighs a great deal, and anything that dies in it leaves the gold behind.

HediffDef.label: golden age
HediffDef.description: Everything is going well and everyone knows it: steadier work, sharper deals.

li.label: golden age
li.description: The colony is rich, the dragon is fat, and for once nothing is on fire that shouldn't be.

HediffDef.label: matriarch's hunger
HediffDef.description: It has eaten its own young and is the stronger for it. Stacks.

ThingDef.label: drakeling
ThingDef.description: A dragon the size of a dog, all teeth and bad temper, hatched from a brood wyrm's clutch. It does not last: it was hatched too fast.

ThingDef.label: dragon's hoard
ThingDef.description: A heap of coin, plate and bright things with a dragon-shaped hollow in the middle. A hoard grows by itself: once a day it yields silver in proportion to the colony's wealth (15 to 180), for as long as the wyrm that owns it lives. It is also very beautiful, in a vulgar way.

ThingDef.label: wyrm nest
ThingDef.description: A nest of scorched earth, bones and shed scales, warm to the touch. Twice a day a brood wyrm leaves two eggs in it: they cook like any egg and each feeds like six.

ThingDef.label: wyrm egg
ThingDef.description: A brood wyrm's egg, rocking gently. Something inside wants out.
